bdf.distributions.BetaMVBernoulli

class bdf.distributions.BetaMVBernoulli(params)[source]

Bases: BDFDistribution[BetaMVBernoulliParams]

Bernoulli-Beta conjugate model with mean-variance parameterization.

Usage: dist="BetaMVBernoulli"

Same conjugate model as BetaABBernoulli, but the prior is specified via interpretable mean and variance rather than concentrations.

Model:

  • Prior: \(p \sim \text{Beta}(\alpha, \beta)\)

  • Likelihood: \(y \mid p \sim \text{Bernoulli}(p)\)

  • Posterior: \(p \mid y \sim \text{Beta}(\alpha + k, \beta + n - k)\)

Parameters:

  • mean_p (float or "auto", default=0.5) – Prior mean \(E[p]\) (expected success probability). If "auto", set to the empirical proportion of 1s at fit time.

  • var_p (float, default=0.1) – Prior variance \(\text{Var}[p]\). Must satisfy var_p < mean_p * (1 - mean_p).

  • raise_on_invalid_var (bool, default=False) – If True, raises an error when var_p exceeds the maximum valid variance. If False, silently adjusts to the maximum valid value.

See also

Common scoring and inference parameters shared by all distributions.

Same model with concentration parameterization.
